definition: Public First Action is a 501(c)(4) nonprofit organization focused on United States public policy related to artificial intelligence.
details: Public First Action is a bipartisan group that advocates for AI transparency, safeguards, and export controls on advanced AI chips. The organization is aligned with the political action committees Jobs and Democracy, Defending Our Values and Public First.

explainer.lead: It is a US 501(c)(4) nonprofit focused on artificial intelligence public policy. It matters as a bipartisan advocacy voice on AI transparency, safeguards and chip export controls.

tiers.eli5: It's a lobbying group that pushes lawmakers on how AI should be regulated.
tiers.practitioner: Those tracking AI policy monitor its advocacy positions; note it is aligned with the PACs Jobs and Democracy, Defending Our Values and Public First, so its political ties should be considered.
